profile.headline: Sr. Electrical/software Engineer at D4C Product Development Inc.
profile.summary:
Hardware/software integration, Embedded system developer. 

Specialties: engineering,  English,  IT help desk support,  Japanese, programming,  Spanish,  structured methods,  supervisory skills,  technical support, cabling,  technical training,  test equipment,  translation, writing, Linux, Debian, C/C++, ARM, Embedded systems

positions.title: Electrical/Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States

positions.title: External Consultant / Embedded Software Developer
positions.description: External development of embedded software and hardware integration for aeronautic applications. C programming in GNU/Linux.

positions.title: Embedded Software Developer
positions.description: Software development, hardware integration and modeling of the camera system for the SENSAT nanosatellite. C programming in GNU/Linux

positions.title: IT Engineer/ R&D Engineer
positions.description:
Duties included the department's transfer from Canada, training of new personnel, supervising and the manufacturing/process engineering.
In charge of the IT (Systems) department. Duties included the implementation and support of IT Infrastructure for the whole plant (Structured cabling), help desk (technical support), phone systems administration and general documentation (ISO).
In charge of Engineering (R&D). Duties included the creation/modification of automatic test profiles for new products (Agilent Visual Programming), calibration/repair of test equipment, technical support & training to the production department as well as ISO documentation for the department.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Testing new models of LCD and CRT televisions.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Internship at the Manufacturing Engineering Department. Translating (English to Spanish) documents of the HPV/ICV electrically controlled water valves.
